scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 31 boards from four live Gilgamesh Domination runs: Emperor civvis-20261116T021437Z (t149-182), Emperor civvis-20261116T024741Z (t150-160), Emperor civvis-20261116T023139Z (t184-190, never held Oil: a no-change control) and Immortal civvis-20261115T230117Z (t135-137). Each board is the run's events.jsonl cut after turn N+1. Both arms run one frozen release civvis_orders --resumed --explain built from the branch at 7810518ecb, with the run's own why.log-header genome as --with. The on arm adds --with guns-keep-the-oil. Orders differ on 6 of 31 boards, all in the two Oil-poor Emperor runs. In 021437Z: at t150 the off arm offers Rome 10 Oil (sell RESOURCE_OIL=10) and the on arm keeps it; at t151 two produce_next orders turn from Infantry to Artillery; at t153 and t154 Isin and Ur take Artillery where the off arm queues Infantry ('displacing infantry at -10000'). In 024741Z: at t151 and t155, one and then two produce_next orders turn from Infantry to Artillery. The 023139Z control agrees on all 3 boards. The 230117Z boards agree, but neither arm issued an upgrade on those frames, so they do not test the upgrade hook.
